readme: ![Twitter badge][Twitter link] ![Bluesky badge][Bluesky link] ![Discord badge][Discord link] ![YouTube badge][YouTube link] Deno (/ˈdiːnoʊ/, pronounced dee-no) is a JavaScript, TypeScript, and WebAssembly runtime with secure defaults and a great developer experience. It's built on V8, Rust, and Tokio.
